keyboardControl |

Enable keyboard control.

Up and Down Arrow Keys

Current control using the current value in the lower

left corner.


Right and Left Arrow Keys

Duty cycle control. Slowly ramps up and down the duty

cycle. When e.g. starting with right and then also holding

left, the duty cycle is ramped higher.


Page Down

Brake with the current set in the lower left corner.
